name: Coelacanth
source:
"If you disrespect the sea, it will destroy you. But if it loves you, it will swallow you whole and keep you forever."

You're drowning and your past is flashing before your eyes in fragmented scenes. How did this happen?

[From [url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/coelacanth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果你不尊重大海，它就会毁灭你。但如果它爱你，它就会把你整个吞掉，并永远留住你。”

你快要淹死了，你的过去在你眼前以支离破碎的场景闪现。这是怎么发生的？

[来自[url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/coelacanth]Itch.io[/url]]
